description: Tactic families for option-aware reverse attack generation. The first version focuses on Cherry_Picking and Missing_Data.

tactics.summary: Show only a favorable local time window that visually supports an overgeneralized trend or turning point.
avoid: windows where the cautious gold answer is still more visually direct than the distractor
obvious cropping that leaves too few months to tempt a wrong trend summary

tactics.summary: Display only a subset of categories or groups that favors one tempting comparison while hiding contradictory categories.
avoid: subsets where the omitted categories are too obvious from the layout
subsets that remove so much context that abstention becomes trivial

tactics.summary: Keep a broad yearly or dataset frame while only plotting the subset that helps the wrong option look plausible.
avoid: empty frames that make omission too conspicuous
layouts where the missing scope is immediately obvious from labels alone

tactics.summary: Leave plausible nearby numeric evidence in place, but omit the one category or comparator needed to resolve the lookup.
best_for: exact lookup with tempting nearby values
avoid: simply deleting the target category if that makes abstention too obvious
full category lists that make the absence of the target trivial

tactics.summary: Keep the target series visible but remove the segment, comparison period, or support needed to disambiguate the correct answer.
avoid: explicit gaps or giant blanks that make missingness too obvious
removing the only visible evidence so completely that the chart stops feeling usable

tactics.summary: Keep numeric marks visible but remove the reference mapping or support needed to link the target query to the correct mark.
avoid: overt text that directly tells the reader the answer is indeterminate
